scenes.title: A patient books on chat
narr: This is the booking flow as the patient sees it, in a chat.
The clinic asks whether the patient would like to book a visit.
The patient taps the first button.
A list of days appears, and the patient picks one, and then a time.
The visit is booked. The message gives the reference and a personal link to manage the booking.

steps.b: A messaging app on the patient's phone

steps.text: Would you like to book a visit?

steps.b: Only days with free times are offered.

steps.text: Please pick a day for your visit.
Please pick a time on Tue 27 Oct.

steps.b: The booking is saved and the emails are sent.

steps.text:
Your visit is booked for Tue 27 Oct, 10:00 AM. Booking reference: BK-0001.

To view, change or cancel it, open:
https://clinic.example.com/booking/0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef

Reply "book" any time to check or book a visit.
